declare(strict_types=1);
if (!extension_loaded("session")) { throw new RuntimeException("session required"); }
$directory = __DIR__ . "/session-files";
if (!is_dir($directory) && !mkdir($directory, 0700)) { throw new RuntimeException("directory failed"); }
ini_set("session.use_cookies", "0");
ini_set("session.cache_limiter", "");
ini_set("session.use_strict_mode", "1");
session_save_path($directory);
if (!session_start()) { throw new RuntimeException("start failed"); }
$id = session_id();
$_SESSION["minutes"] = 15;
if (!session_write_close()) { throw new RuntimeException("save failed"); }
$_SESSION = [];
session_id($id);
if (!session_start()) { throw new RuntimeException("reload failed"); }
$value = $_SESSION["minutes"] ?? "missing";
if (!session_destroy()) { throw new RuntimeException("destroy failed"); }
echo $value, "\n";

declare(strict_types=1);
$input = ["15", "bad", "0", "20"];
$accepted = [];
foreach ($input as $text) {
    $minutes = filter_var($text, FILTER_VALIDATE_INT, ["options" => ["min_range" => 1, "max_range" => 60]]);
